arguments.description: Rebuild staging results model and verify row counts

text:
The staging results table was dropping rows because of an inner join. I changed it to a left join and rebuilt the table; it now has all 26,599 rows, matching the source.

**Cause:** In `models/staging/f1_dataset/stg_f1_dataset__results.sql`, results were joined to `position_descriptions` with an inner join on `position_text`. That lookup only contains the non-finishing codes (D, E, F, N, R, W). Any result with a numeric finishing position (1, 2, 3, …) had no match and was discarded. That was 15,669 of the 26,599 source rows. The status join drops nothing, so I left it as an inner join.

**Fix:** Changed `join position_descriptions as p` to `left join position_descriptions as p`. The `position_desc` column is now NULL for numeric finishers, which is expected since they have no description code.

**Verification:**
- `dbt run --select stg_f1_dataset__results` completed successfully.
- The table now has 26,599 rows, matching `src_results`.
- 15,669 rows have a NULL `position_desc`, which are exactly the numeric-position rows.

I only rebuilt this one model. Downstream models that read from it (the `stats` models, for example) still have the old data until you run them, so their results may change.

VERDICT: fixed
